code_generation.definition: The automatic production of program code from a natural-language description or an example.

honey.definition: The sweet golden food that bees make from flowers.
honey.example: The bees made twelve pots of golden honey.

juice.definition: The liquid water inside a fruit.
juice.example: I squeeze some lime juice over the fruit.

pd_institutional_power.definition: Power that belongs to an office or an organisation rather than to a person, and passes on with the role.
pd_institutional_power.example: Institutional power is why the badge opens the door even though the badge is not the man.

pump_backflow.definition: Water moving in the wrong direction, back along the pipe towards the pump.
pump_backflow.example: After the supply stops, backflow can leave the pump running with no water.

service_charge.definition: A percentage added to the bill for service, usually 10 % or 15 %. When it is included, tipping again is not expected.
service_charge.example: The service charge is already on the bill, so we will just round it up.

shirt.definition: A top with a collar that you wear over your body, on its own or under a jacket.
shirt.example: My school shirt has a blue collar.

treat.definition: To deal with something in a particular way.
